[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import data.list.basic

def implementation (numbers: List Rat) (threshold: Rat) : Bool :=
let rec loop (i: Nat) (j: Nat) : Bool :=
  if i = numbers.length then
    false
  else if j = numbers.length then
    loop (i + 1) i
  else if i = j then
    loop i (j + 1)
  else
    if (numbers.get! i - numbers.get! j).abs < threshold then
      true
    else
      loop i (j + 1)
loop 0 1
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma abs_sub_comm (a b : Rat) : (a - b).abs = (b - a).abs :=
by linarith

lemma abs_sub_pos (a b : Rat) (h : a < b) : (a - b).abs = b - a :=
by linarith

lemma abs_sub_neg (a b : Rat) (h : b < a) : (a - b).abs = a - b :=
by linarith

  linarith
rename_i j' j ih
by_cases h_j_le_i': j' < i'

simp [h_j_le_i'] at h_i_ne_j

have h_j'_ne_j: j'' ≠ j := by 
  linarith
